t.why: Rich in gold, copper and gas. In 2025 it signed a mutual defense treaty with Australia.
t.rel: It shares the island of New Guinea with Indonesia and is close to Australia, with which it signed a mutual defense treaty in 2025.
t.korea: Korean companies have taken part in gas development there.
t.know: With more than 800 languages, it has more languages than any other country.
t.etext: It sells liquefied natural gas, gold, copper, palm oil and timber. Resources are plentiful, but roads and power are scarce and security is poor.
